addition.item: Gallery mode: responsive thumbnail grid (2/3/4 columns, gap, aspect ratio) with inline or modal/lightbox viewer
Thumbnails are generated automatically when saving (correct equirectangular-to-perspective projection, PHP GD)
Large panoramas (e.g. 15520x7760 px drone images) are downscaled first (ImageMagick, Imagick extension or GD)
Optional vertical divider, hover effect, custom CSS class and gallery title
Keyboard navigation and accessibility for the gallery
Notice on installation if the PHP GD extension is missing

change.item: Module restructured to current Joomla 5/6 conventions (service provider, dispatcher, namespaced classes)
All remaining hard-coded texts moved to the language files (German and English)
"Auto load" now defaults to "No" for new modules
Unused thumbnails are cleaned up automatically and removed on uninstall

note.item: The PHP GD extension is required for the gallery mode. ImageMagick is recommended for large panoramas.

fix.item: Using several Pannellum modules on the same page caused a 500 error
The auto-load setting was ignored in multi-scene mode
Compass, auto-rotation speed and delay settings had no effect

addition.item: "Loading..." texts are now translatable via language files

change.item: Removed debug console output from the frontend JavaScript

note.item: First public release: single panorama and multi-scene mode with hotspot editor
